The '''Rusty Spoon''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[Pelican Town]], from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]], or from [[Artifact Trove]]s.  It can also be found by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[the Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Tailoring==
Rusty Spoon is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Rusty Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt233.png|24px]]

==Quests==
One Rusty Spoon may be requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fifth request, or as part of any request starting with the sixth.
